name: Indian Toners & Developers Limited
summary: Specializing in the production and global distribution of toners and related consumables, Indian Toners & Developers Ltd. supplies essential materials for printers and photocopiers. Their extensive product catalog features chemical color, laser, and digital copier toners, alongside solutions for wide-format printing and copying, and associated packaging. The company was established in 1990 by Sushil Jain Kumar and maintains its primary corporate office in New Delhi, India.
